page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated compute cores relative to memory makes this instance suitable for CPU-bound workloads that do not demand massive memory footprints, optimizing resource spend by avoiding over-provisioned RAM.

The hardware configuration of the ecs.c6t.26xlarge makes it appropriate for compute-intensive workloads. Suitable use cases include high-performance web serving, batch processing, scientific modeling, video encoding, and distributed analytics frameworks that scale horizontally across high vCPU counts without requiring local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.
